acceptanceRequires: This receipt alone never establishes success. Require observed wrapper terminal exit 0 within the absolute deadline, active-zero/process-exit observations and confirmed handle/mutex cleanup. A late or failed receipt finalization forces wrapper exit 1 even if this provisional file contains passed=true.
clockScope: First monotonic reading before imports, mutex and admission
deadlineScope: Absolute scheduling deadlines; synchronous WinAPI and receipt I/O are not preemptible. Final exit status fails if receipt completion crosses +205s.
errors: Shared validation lane busy; no admission or child started
